title: Photo toolbar hides, not re-places, when its photo starts in the composer's bottom inset band
context: PR 187 review (switch-over): photoToolbarOffset took the slot above a photo even when the bar then ran into the bottom inset band under the floating footer, so presses on the bar's lower half landed on the footer. Rejecting that slot alone makes the ride-on-edge fallback place the bar detached from the photo when the photo is below the band. The engine's own visibility check (note_editor_view.dart, not a PR file) uses visibleContentRect, which includes the band.
options: Reject the above slot only; let the fallback clamp the bar to the surface bottom
Reject the above slot and hide the bar in PhotoToolbarLayer when the figure does not intersect the surface above the inset
Change the engine's visibility check to exclude the bottom inset
outcome: Reject the above slot unless the bar ends at or above surface.bottom, and have PhotoToolbarLayer drop the bar (keeping the caption field) when the figure does not overlap the surface above the inset. The engine option was out of the PR's files. Committed as a9d075f on mitosis/switch-over.
